_comment: Sentence generators ported from the Tag & Tally Obsidian vault (game/generators/*.md). Syntax: {table} rolls a table; {table|tag} wraps the result as a [tag]; {=table} reuses the first roll of that table; {=table.field} reads a column of that row; {a-[b]} rolls table a-<slug of b's result>; {x ?? y} falls back to y when x is missing; |lower and |title change case. Tables are looked up as <theme>-<name> first, then <name>.

generators.label: NPC
generators.template: **{name-patterns|title}** is a {descriptor|tag} {species|tag} {type-[type-option]|tag} who {does-something|tag}. They are motivated by [{character-motivation-verb|lower} {character-motivation-noun|lower}] and want to [{=quest-type|lower} {quest-objective-[quest-type]|lower}]. In combat, they deal {wound-damage|tag} damage with {character-attack-choice|tag}, but they {character-secret|tag}.
